slither.reasoning: `block.timestamp > action.deadline` decides expiry of an unexecuted instruction. A block producer can shift the timestamp slightly, so an action may be accepted or refused a few seconds around its deadline. Bounded: the deadline is a coarse expiry (the application signs at most 600 seconds ahead), it never affects an issued receipt, and the reviewer can cancel earlier with invalidateNonce. No value is at stake in the registry.
